custom_summary: Put up to 3 projects on Digivated at once, each live the moment you publish. $3 once.
description:
Starter: 3 projects on Digivated.

Starter is a $3 USD one-time purchase. There are no recurring charges.

Up to 3 projects, live instantly

Every Digivated account gets one project for free. Starter raises that to 3 projects on the site at once, and each one goes live the moment you publish it, with no review queue and no badge needed. Archive or delete a project to free a slot. Want unlimited projects and full site access? Get Digivated Membership ($5) instead.

How to use it

Buy with the same email as your Digivated account. Then open https://digivated.com/submit-project and press “I’ve paid, check again”. Projects must follow the listing rules; traffic, engagement, and sales are not guaranteed.

Checkout shows applicable taxes and purchase terms.
